run_affinitize_irqs: run the CLI tool to affinitize NIC IRQs to specific CPU cores on a network interface
run_show_netdev: run the CLI tool with --show to display IRQ, RPS, and XPS configuration for a NIC
run_randomize_interrupts: run the CLI tool with --randomize to daemonize and periodically rebalance NIC interrupts across CPUs
run_configure_rps_xps: run the CLI tool with --rps and --xps flags to enable receive and transmit packet steering
run_dry_run_affinitize: run the CLI tool with --dry-run to preview IRQ affinity changes without applying them
